I will keep my farm simple and steady. In Quzhou County, the crop pattern I trust most is winter wheat followed by summer maize, because that fits the local weather, the land, and the way I know how to farm. At my age, I will not take on crops that need too much labor or too much market risk. If I already have winter wheat in the field at the start of the season, I will manage that crop through harvest, then I will plant summer maize right after. I will use improved or hybrid seed, not because I want to chase something fancy, but because I want stable emergence, better yield, and less trouble. I will keep fertilizer at moderate levels, use rotary tillage because it is easier to arrange, irrigate only at the key growth stages, and spray only when pressure is real. I will aim for reliable production more than maximum production, because for me the safest plan is the best plan.
